DialogRoot.description: Holds the dialog's open state and shares it with the parts inside it.

props.open: Whether the dialog is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the dialog.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the dialog is open at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called when a part, Escape or a press outside asks to open or close the dialog. A controlled dialog changes only when `open` does, so it can refuse to close.
props.modal: Whether the dialog is opened with `showModal()`: in the top layer, with a backdrop, the page behind it inert and its scroll locked. With `false` it is opened with `show()` and the page stays usable.
props.dismissible: Whether Escape and a press outside close the dialog. With `false` only its own buttons do.
props.disablePointerDismissal: Whether a press outside is ignored. Escape still closes the dialog.
props.role: The popup's role. `"alertdialog"` is written on the `<dialog>`; AlertDialogRoot sets it.

DialogTrigger.description: The button that opens the dialog. It carries `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the dialog is open.

DialogPopup.description: The `<dialog>` element. Style it with `[open]`, `::backdrop`, `@starting-style` and `[data-ending-style]`. Its `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` point at the title and description.

dataAttributes.data-ending-style: Present while the dialog animates out. The dialog stays open until the transitions and animations on it and its descendants finish.

DialogTitle.description: A heading that names the dialog. The popup's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

DialogDescription.description: A paragraph that describes the dialog. The popup's `aria-describedby` points at it.

DialogClose.description: A button that closes the dialog. In a controlled dialog it asks through `onOpenChange`.
